name: Decompose With Me
source:
You wake up to find yourself in the woods with no memory of how you got there. A cute girl stands above you. Is she there to help, or does she want something else...?

[from [url=https://lunaraydue.itch.io/decompose-with-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你醒来发现自己在树林里，却不记得自己是如何到达那里的。一个可爱的女孩站在你的上方。她是来帮忙的，还是想要别的东西……？

[来自[url=https://lunaraydue.itch.io/decompose-with-me]itch.io[/url]]
